summary_markdown: The discussion centered on the timing and method of announcing new AI prompt capabilities for dashboards. Initially, [p1] suggested announcing an alpha version of the AI prompts for the next release. [me] advised against a formal announcement, suggesting instead that the feature be shown in development to create a 'wow effect.' Later, it was acknowledged that while a surprise reveal is appealing, internal policy and departmental interests suggest that an earlier announcement might be necessary.
decisions: The timing of announcing AI prompt features for dashboards needs further consideration based on internal policy.
